newsitem.title: USA: Stone & Webster wins $55 mln Ghana contract.
newsitem.headline: Stone & Webster wins $55 mln Ghana contract.

text.p: Stone & Webster Inc said Tuesday it won a $55 million contract from the Volta River Authority, Ghana's electric utility, to provide engineering, procurement and construction services for the second phase of the 350 megawatt Takoradi Power Station.
The company said its project partner is General Electric Co, which is providing equipment. Work on the project, began in April and is expected to finish by September 1998, Stone & Webster said.
In the next year, Stone & Webster said it plans to bid on further contracts at Takoradi that could be worth at least $130 million.
Stone & Webster provides engineering, construction, and consulting services for the power, process, environmental infrastructure and industrial markets.
